lines.en: label yasudorm10:
scene dorm2
I knock on Yasu’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Yasu 的门，等她来应。

lines.en: Why? I have no idea.
lines.zh: 为什么？我不知道。

lines.en: But it’s a thing I do and now I have to live with the consequences.
lines.zh: 但这是我做的事，现在后果我得自己担着。

lines.en: And I don’t mean consequences in the sense that I think tragedy might befall me for simply doing this-
lines.zh: 而我说的「后果」，不是指我觉得光是做这件事就会招来什么灾祸——

lines.en: But moreso in the fact that from this point on, I will be completely out of my element and, as such, out of control.
lines.zh: 更多是指：从这一刻起，我会彻底离开自己的地盘，因而也彻底失控。

lines.en: It’s rather interesting, really.
lines.zh: 这其实挺有意思的。

lines.en: I normally feel like I have the upper hand when it comes to conversing with everyone who lives in this building.
lines.zh: 平时跟这栋楼里的人说话，我总觉得是自己占上风。

lines.en: Let’s look at Touka, for example.
lines.zh: 拿 Touka 举例吧。

lines.en: scene realtoukaimage
Touka is a girl who is not Yasu but sleeps in the same room as Yasu.
lines.zh: Touka 是个不是 Yasu、却跟 Yasu 睡同一间房的女孩。

lines.en: If you pay close attention to the image in front of you, you will see that she is frowning.
lines.zh: 你要是仔细看眼前的画面，会发现她在皱眉。

lines.en: But why?
lines.zh: 但为什么呢？

lines.en: Is it because we have not done the sex to her yet?
lines.zh: 是因为我们还没对她做过「那个」吗？

lines.en: Probably not.
lines.zh: 大概不是。

lines.en: Though I would not doubt that she has, on several occasions, had to contemplate whether or not the act of pleasuring herself in the same room as a semi-comatose half nun would be moral or not.
lines.zh: 不过我毫不怀疑，她多半有几次不得不盘算：在一个半昏迷状态的半修女待的同一个房间里取悦自己，到底道不道德。

lines.en: I would not think any less of her if she tried, but do not expect that she would have been able to do it to completion because of how strange it would likely be.
lines.zh: 她要是真试了，我不会因此看轻她；但也别指望她能做到最后——因为那实在太怪了。

lines.en: Masturbatory tangent aside, Touka is probably frowning because she is one of the girls that I typically have the upper hand with.
lines.zh: 自慰的话题先放一边，Touka 皱眉，大概因为她是那种我通常占上风的女孩之一。

lines.en: Not just because my hands can reach higher things than hers, but because she is a weak little girl and I am a big strong man.
lines.zh: 不只是因为我的手能够到比她更高的东西，而是因为她是个弱小的小女孩，而我是个高大强壮的男人。

lines.en: I will do the sex to her and make her smile happen.
lines.zh: 我会对她做「那个」，让她笑出来。

lines.en: scene dorm2
I knock on Yasu’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Yasu 的门，等她来应。

lines.en: Why? I have no idea.
lines.zh: 为什么？我不知道。

lines.en: But it’s a thing I do and now I have to live with the consequences.
lines.zh: 但这是我做的事，现在后果我得自己担着。

lines.en: : Come in!
lines.zh: : 请进！

lines.en: scene black
scene yasufirstdorm1
: Good morning, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 早上好，Sensei。

lines.en: : It’s nighttime, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 现在是夜里，Yasu。

lines.en: : Is it? I suppose I lost track of time in the midst of prayer.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我想我是在祈祷中忘了时间。

lines.en: : It would not be the first time I’ve let an entire period of day slip by without noticing.
lines.zh: : 这不是我第一次让一整段时间不知不觉溜走。

lines.en: : Fair enough. Don’t you want to turn the lights on, though?
lines.zh: : 说得也是。不过你不想开灯吗？

lines.en: : Not particularly.
lines.zh: : 不太想。

lines.en: : There is only one light that matters to me. The rest of them are nothing but hindrances meant to-
lines.zh: : 对我来说只有一种光是重要的。其余的都不过是障碍，注定要——

lines.en: : Before you continue that, I just want to make sure you’re going to put it in terms that I understand and not some weird religious way.
lines.zh: : 在你继续之前，我只想确认一下：你要用我能听懂的说法，而不是某种奇怪的宗教腔。

lines.en: : Sunlight hurts my eyes and my skin.
lines.zh: : 阳光会刺痛我的眼睛和皮肤。

lines.en: : It makes coming to[school] very difficult sometimes.
lines.zh: : 有时候来[学校]会变得很困难。

lines.en: scene yasufirstdorm2
: But I am a good girl and will do what God tells me to do.
lines.zh: : 但我是个乖女孩，会照上帝说的做。

lines.en: : Well I’m happy to hear your god is concerned about your education.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴听到你的神关心你的学业。

lines.en: scene yasufirstdorm3
: He is more concerned with spreading the message of His love than of my menial general studies.
lines.zh: : 比起我那些微不足道的通识课，祂更关心传播祂爱的信息。

lines.en: : There are no better candidates for angels than [adolescent] girls, untouched by the evils of man and untainted by the stink of life.
lines.zh: : 没有谁比[青春期]女孩更适合当天使的候选人了——她们未被人类的邪恶触碰，也未被生活的臭味污染。

lines.en: : Well, uhh...good luck.
lines.zh: : 嗯，呃……祝你好运。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t count on everyone being {i}untainted{/i}, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我可不指望人人都「{i}未被污染{/i}」。

lines.en: : Even {i}if{/i} they’ve already been contaminated, they are not so broken that they are beyond repair.
lines.zh: : {i}就算{/i}她们已经被污染了，也没有坏到无法修复的地步。

lines.en: : Life is long. And if they wish to atone for any misdeeds they may have done, now is the best possible time to begin their repentance.
lines.zh: : 人生很长。如果她们想为自己犯下的过错赎罪，现在正是开始忏悔的最好时机。

lines.en: : They can all still be saved. And it is my duty as an angel in training to usher them to safety like the confused sheep they are.
lines.zh: : 她们全都还能被拯救。而作为见习天使，我的职责就是把她们这群迷途的羊引到安全的地方。

lines.en: : Just...don’t repeat any of that out loud to them or it will be even harder for you to make friends than it is for Touka.
lines.zh: : 只是……别把这些话当着她们的面重复，不然你想交到朋友，会比 Touka 还难。

lines.en: scene realtoukaimage
scene yasufirstdorm4
: LET US WALK!
lines.zh: : 我们走吧！

lines.en: : Woah, what?
lines.zh: : 哇，什么？

lines.en: : I TIRE OF THESE WALLS!
lines.zh: : 我受够这些墙了！

lines.en: : LET US GO SOMEWHERE ELSE!
lines.zh: : 我们去别的地方！

lines.en: : We don’t have to hang out here, but I’d certainly appreciate it if you’d stop yelling.
lines.zh: : 我们不必非待在这儿，不过你要是别再喊了，我会很感激。

lines.en: scene yasufirstdorm5
: I can do that.
lines.zh: : 我能做到。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Sensei. A sudden urge came over me and I was not able to suppress it.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Sensei。一股冲动突然袭来，我没能压住。

lines.en: : The first hours after I pray are the hours when the noises become loudest.
lines.zh: : 我祈祷后的头几个小时，是那些声音最响的时候。

lines.en: : I can’t help it if they take over sometimes.
lines.zh: : 它们有时候占了上风，我也没办法。

lines.en: : I hope it will not ruin our blossoming friendship or any chance you have of following me in the future.
lines.zh: : 希望这不会毁掉我们刚萌芽的友谊，也不会毁掉你将来跟随我的任何可能。

lines.en: scene yasufirstdorm1
: But for now, I shall follow {i}you{/i}.
lines.zh: : 但现在，我来跟随{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : I leave you in charge of taking me somewhere exciting.
lines.zh: : 带我去个好玩的地方，这事就交给你了。

lines.en: : That’s a big ask when I know your preferred hang out spots are a church and directly in front of your bedroom wall.
lines.zh: : 这要求可够高的——我知道你爱待的地方就两个：教堂，还有你卧室墙根底下。

lines.en: : I’m not really sure if we find the same things “exciting.”
lines.zh: : 我真不确定我们觉得「好玩」的是不是同一类东西。

lines.en: : Hmm...I suppose we most likely don’t.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想大概不是。

lines.en: : Oh, here is an idea.
lines.zh: : 哦，有了个主意。

lines.en: : How would you like to return to the spot where we first met?
lines.zh: : 回到我们初次相遇的地方，你觉得怎么样？

lines.en: : Great idea. Nothing says exciting like the place where I watched you cause the most innocent girl in my class to break out in tears.
lines.zh: : 好主意。还有什么比「我看着你把班上最天真的女孩弄哭的地方」更让人兴奋的呢。

lines.en: scene yasufirstdorm6
: Not all tears are bad, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不是所有的眼泪都是坏的，Sensei。

lines.en: : Even if my words brought them to her eyes, I’m sure they were for happy reasons.
lines.zh: : 就算是我的话让它们涌进她眼里，我也相信那是出于幸福。

lines.en: : For she had likely heard something she’d been waiting to hear for a very long time.
lines.zh: : 因为她很可能听到了某件她等了很久的话。

lines.en: : What does that-
lines.zh: : 这话什么意思——

lines.en: scene yasufirstdorm5
: But for now, let us go! Adventure awaits!
lines.zh: : 不过现在，我们走吧！冒险在等着！

lines.en: scene black
: Okay, I guess.
lines.zh: : 好吧，听你的。

lines.en: Yasu puts her shoes on and the two of us make our way out of the dorms and into the streets.
lines.zh: Yasu 穿上鞋，我们俩走出宿舍，来到街上。

lines.en: I’ve been to the park where I met Yasu on several other occasions since then, so I know where we’re heading and lead the way.
lines.zh: 那座我遇见 Yasu 的公园，之后我又去过几次，所以我知道我们要去哪儿，我在前面带路。

lines.en: There isn’t much discussion on the way there, but it’s not really an uncomfortable silence or anything like that.
lines.zh: 路上没怎么说话，但那也不是什么让人不舒服的沉默。

lines.en: In fact, the silence is probably even more comfortable than the parts of the night where we're talking.
lines.zh: 事实上，这份沉默大概比我们说话的那些时候还要舒服。

lines.en: Maybe Yasu and I should just remain quiet all the time?
lines.zh: 也许我和 Yasu 就该一直保持安静？

lines.en: It might be a little boring at first, but at least I won’t be tempted into joining a cult based on the promise of transferring spiritual warmth through my penis.
lines.zh: 一开始可能会有点无聊，但至少我不会被人用「通过我的阴茎传递灵性的温暖」这种承诺哄进邪教。

lines.en: I’ve still yet to wrap my head around that.
lines.zh: 这件事我到现在还没想明白。

lines.en: scene yasufirstdorm7
: Did you really have to bring the umbrella?
lines.zh: : 你真非得把伞带上吗？

lines.en: : I must have instinctively grabbed it thinking it was morning again.
lines.zh: : 我大概是下意识抓起来的，以为又是早上了。

lines.en: : You’re still on that?
lines.zh: : 你还在纠结这个？

lines.en: : I suppose so.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。

lines.en: : It’s a bit of a reflex at this point, though. I’ve despised the sun ever since I was a little girl.
lines.zh: : 不过到这地步已经有点条件反射了。我从小女孩的时候起就讨厌太阳。

lines.en: : I somehow have a hard time imagining a younger version of you.
lines.zh: : 不知怎么，我很难想象你小时候的样子。

lines.en: : Why is that?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : You’re just so...eccentric now that I can’t imagine a time where you weren’t like that.
lines.zh: : 你现在太……古怪了，我都没法想象有哪个时候你不是这样。

lines.en: : And I have a hard time believing you’ve been a religious fanatic since you were born.
lines.zh: : 而且我很难相信你打从出生起就是个宗教狂热分子。

lines.en: scene yasufirstdorm8
: Fanatic sounds a little hurtful.
lines.zh: : 「狂热分子」听着有点伤人。

lines.en: : It makes it sound like I’m over the top or irrational.
lines.zh: : 听起来像是在说我过头了、或者不理性。

lines.en: : Oh, I know how it sounds.
lines.zh: : 哦，我知道这词听起来什么样。

lines.en: : I spoke about it at the church, but there are things etched into us at birth that play a great role in determining our purpose. The people we hope to become.
lines.zh: : 我在教堂里说过，有些东西在出生时就被刻进了我们身上，它们在决定我们的使命、我们想成为什么样的人上，起着很大的作用。

lines.en: : Do you think this version of me is the result of a single event and not simply the way I was designed?
lines.zh: : 你觉得现在这个我，是某件单一事件的结果，而不只是我被设计成的样子吗？

lines.en: : So...you {i}have{/i} been insane ever since you were born?
lines.zh: : 所以……你打从出生起{i}就{/i}疯了？

lines.en: scene yasufirstdorm9
: That seems to be the consensus.
lines.zh: : 大家似乎是这么认为的。

lines.en: : If you were to ask anyone that knew me back then, I’m sure they would tell you you’re correct.
lines.zh: : 你要是去问那时候认识我的人，我确信他们会告诉你你是对的。

lines.en: : I am far from insane, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我远没有疯。

lines.en: : I actually find myself to be more rational and level headed than anyone when I’m not listening to the voices trapped in the aether.
lines.zh: : 事实上，当我不去听那些困在「以太」里的声音时，我发现自己比任何人都理性、冷静。

lines.en: : Yasu, the reason so many people think you’re insane is very likely because you say things like that.
lines.zh: : Yasu，那么多人觉得你疯了，很可能就是因为你说了这种话。

lines.en: : Having better hearing than anyone else makes me insane?
lines.zh: : 听力比别人好，就让我成了疯子？

lines.en: : No, but thinking there are voices floating around in “the aether” kind of does.
lines.zh: : 不是，但觉得有声音飘在「以太」里这种话，多少算是。

lines.en: : What does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么意思？

lines.en: scene yasufirstdorm10
: You know what a {i}soul{/i} is, correct?
lines.zh: : 你知道{i}灵魂{/i}是什么，对吧？

lines.en: : In the vague moral sense, yes. But in the religious one...kind of?
lines.zh: : 在模糊的道德意义上，知道。但宗教意义上的……算是吧？

lines.en: : Something about an imaginary entity inside of you that contains your consciousness and history or whatever mumbo jumbo they use to trick kids into thinking there is an afterlife.
lines.zh: : 大概是你体内某个想象出来的实体，装着你的意识和经历，或者随便他们用来哄小孩相信有来世的什么鬼话。

lines.en: : That is such a sad way to look at things.
lines.zh: : 用这种眼光看事情，真让人难过。

lines.en: : The soul is not imaginary. Though, it’s a bit more complicated than an invisible stream of consciousness.
lines.zh: : 灵魂不是想象出来的。不过它比一条看不见的意识流要复杂一些。

lines.en: : If your body is the container that stores your thoughts now, what would happen if you switched containers?
lines.zh: : 如果你的身体是现在存放你思想的容器，那么如果你换个容器，会发生什么？

lines.en: : What if you no longer had a use for your body as you were able to simply store your thoughts in the world itself?
lines.zh: : 要是你不再需要身体，因为你可以直接把思想存在世界本身里呢？

lines.en: : Isn’t that an invisible stream of consciousness?
lines.zh: : 那不还是一条看不见的意识流吗？

lines.en: scene yasufirstdorm11
: Yes. But like I said, it’s more complicated than that.
lines.zh: : 是的。不过就像我说的，比那复杂。

lines.en: scene yasufirstdorm8
: Some fake religions certainly do deceive people with the promise of souls moving into the afterlife.
lines.zh: : 有些假宗教确实拿「灵魂进入来世」的承诺骗人。

lines.en: : But as I know with absolute certainty, for I see the light and hear the light, the afterlife is all around us.
lines.zh: : 但我以绝对的把握知道——因为我看见那光，也听见那光——来世就在我们周围。

lines.en: : There is a second plane of existence that lies directly on top of our current plane.
lines.zh: : 在我们现在的位面正上方，紧贴着存在另一个位面。

lines.en: : It’s just impossible to see with your eyes only partially open.
lines.zh: : 只是你的眼睛只睁开了一半，看不见罢了。

lines.en: : So basically, once someone dies, their consciousness exits their body, but continues to exist outside of it?
lines.zh: : 也就是说，人死后，意识离开身体，但继续在身体之外存在？

lines.en: scene yasufirstdorm7
: That is the gist of it.
lines.zh: : 大体就是这个意思。

lines.en: : Yeah, we should take you to a hospital. Let’s go.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我们应该送你去医院。走吧。

lines.en: : Oh, stop. What makes this possibility any less believable than a fortress in the clouds or being reborn as a plant?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这样。这种可能，凭什么就比云上的堡垒、或者转世成一株植物更不可信？

lines.en: : To die is to disappear. And since it’s impossible to fully vanish, there is no death.
lines.zh: : 死就是消失。而不可能彻底消失，所以没有死亡。

lines.en: : What you’re saying isn’t exactly {i}less{/i} believable. It’s that none of those things are believable in the first place.
lines.zh: : 你说的倒不是{i}更不可信{/i}。问题在于那些东西本来就都不可信。

lines.en: : So you are one of those people who believes in eternal darkness succeeding the end of traditional life?
lines.zh: : 那你就是那种相信传统生命终结之后是永恒黑暗的人咯？

lines.en: : I guess you could say that. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 你可以这么说。对。

lines.en: : And are you happy with that way of thinking?
lines.zh: : 你满意这种想法吗？

lines.en: : I’m not {i}unhappy{/i} with it.
lines.zh: : 我{i}不讨厌{/i}它。

lines.en: : You are very good at dodging questions you find inconvenient, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你很擅长回避自己觉得不方便的问题，对吧？

lines.en: : It’s definitely one of my strengths.
lines.zh: : 这绝对是我的强项之一。

lines.en: : What can I do to have you reconsider?
lines.zh: : 我要怎么做，才能让你重新考虑？

lines.en: : Would hearing the disembodied whispers of friends or lovers past grant you the solace you need to try a new system of beliefs?
lines.zh: : 要是听见逝去的亲友那没有实体的低语，能给你需要的安慰，让你愿意试试一套新的信仰呢？

lines.en: : To step out into the night and spread your arms, letting tendrils of the winter winds wrap around you and embrace you the way you long to be embraced.
lines.zh: : 走进夜色里张开双臂，让冬风的触须缠住你、拥抱你——以你渴望被拥抱的方式。

lines.en: : We are sensitive creatures, you and me. You and me and everyone else.
lines.zh: : 我们都是敏感的生物，你和我。你和我，还有所有人。

lines.en: : I am far from sensitive. “Detached” is probably a better word.
lines.zh: : 我一点也不敏感。「疏离」大概是更准确的词。

lines.en: : You and your silly textbook definitions of words...
lines.zh: : 你和你那些愚蠢的词典定义……

lines.en: : I do not mean sensitive emotionally and physically.
lines.zh: : 我说的不是情感和身体上的敏感。

lines.en: : I mean sensitive in the fact that our entire existences could be entirely rewritten by even the most minor of events.
lines.zh: : 我说的是：我们的整个存在，都可能被最微小的事件彻底改写。

lines.en: : If you heard the things I hear, you would believe. And I would not have to ask you to follow.
lines.zh: : 你要是听见了我听见的东西，你就会信。而我也就不必请你跟随。

lines.en: : You would simply fall into line alongside me and spread His word for the rest of the world to hear.
lines.zh: : 你会自然而然地排到我身边，把祂的话语传遍世界，让剩下的人都听见。

lines.en: : We’d approach the end of days together, and I would carry you to the place where all is safe with the help of my new wings.
lines.zh: : 我们会一起走向末日，而我会用我新生的翅膀，把你带到那个万物皆安的地方。

lines.en: : And yet you still feel inclined to disbelieve me.
lines.zh: : 可你依然不肯信我。

lines.en: : Yes. Because you are crazy.
lines.zh: : 对。因为你疯了。

lines.en: : If believing in what I know to be the truth is crazy, I fear for the rest of this city.
lines.zh: : 如果相信我所知道的真相就叫疯，那我为这座城市剩下的人担忧。

lines.en: : I fear the thoughts they must have. The lack of closure. The sensation of a loved one wrapping around them as they make their way down the street.
lines.zh: : 我担忧他们脑子里必定在想什么。那种无法了结的感觉。那种所爱之人缠上他们、陪他们沿街走去的感觉。

lines.en: : I fear those who will not accept messages from the one person in the world who can carry them.
lines.zh: : 我担忧那些不肯接受信息的人——不肯接受来自这世上唯一能传递这些信息的人。

lines.en: : I fear everything and nothing at all.
lines.zh: : 我什么都怕，又什么都不怕。

lines.en: scene yasufirstdorm12
: I fear you.
lines.zh: : 我怕你。

lines.en: : Me?
: You. Surrounded by a thick blanket that forces back the whispers of someone so lonely it shakes the earth to the core.
lines.zh: : 你。被一层厚毯子裹着，把某个孤独到令大地震颤的人的低语挡了回去。

lines.en: : You. Who not only denies what he has seen, but attempts to carve out paths in all directions and separate his body into pieces so he may walk down all of them at once.
lines.zh: : 你。不仅否认自己看见的东西，还试图在四面八方都开出路来，把自己的身体切成碎块，好让自己能同时走遍所有路。

lines.en: : You. Who is blessed and cursed at the same time. Who is both the purest entity I have ever seen and a person so tainted that it’s a miracle you can still walk.
lines.zh: : 你。同时被祝福又被诅咒。既是我见过最纯净的存在，又是一个被玷污到还能走路都算奇迹的人。

lines.en: : You, who lives.
lines.zh: : 你，活着。

lines.en: : You exist as both my greatest fear and my greatest hope. For all that I am will surely rely on you before you are ready to be relied on.
lines.zh: : 你同时是我最大的恐惧，也是我最大的希望。因为我的一切，注定要在你准备好被依靠之前，就先依靠你。

lines.en: : That is why I fear everything and nothing at all.
lines.zh: : 这就是为什么我什么都怕，又什么都不怕。

lines.en: : Not because I can hear the whispers and wishes in rivers of lost souls.
lines.zh: : 不是因为我能听见失魂者之河里的低语与愿望。

lines.en: : Not because I can feel the pain in every person and every place.
lines.zh: : 不是因为我能感觉到每一个地方、每一个人身上的痛。

lines.en: : But because I can not feel you.
lines.zh: : 而是因为我感觉不到你。

lines.en: scene yasufirstdorm13
: Are you sure you don’t want to go to the hospital?
lines.zh: : 你确定你不想去医院吗？

lines.en: : Hehehe~
lines.zh: : 呵呵呵~

lines.en: : I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 我确定。

lines.en: : I’m a rational girl. And I’ve already been a little pushier about earning your trust than He wants me to be.
lines.zh: : 我是个理性的女孩。而且在赢得你信任这件事上，我已经比祂希望我做的要更急切了一点。

lines.en: : But I can’t help but worry about the end of the world when I can feel it looming on the horizon.
lines.zh: : 可当我感觉到末日就悬在地平线上时，我就是忍不住担心。

lines.en: : Before long, the snow will melt.
lines.zh: : 过不了多久，雪就会融化。

lines.en: : The seasons will change.
lines.zh: : 季节会更替。

lines.en: : And His slumber will come to its end.
lines.zh: : 而祂的沉睡将走到尽头。

lines.en: : Perhaps it is only then that you will learn to accept the truth in everything.
lines.zh: : 也许到那时，你才会学会接受这一切里的真相。

lines.en: scene yasufirstdorm14
: I am not crazy, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我没疯。

lines.en: : I am chosen.
lines.zh: : 我是被选中的。

lines.en: : I am the sole bearer of the word of truth and the sole believer of the light.
lines.zh: : 我是真理之言唯一的承载者，也是那光唯一的信徒。

lines.en: : And through the gift of the divine and the aetheric whispers of all else who have learned the truth-
lines.zh: : 而借着神圣的恩赐，以及所有已经得知真相者那以太般的低语——

lines.en: : I will teach you.
lines.zh: : 我会教你的。

lines.en: : I will give you myself and you will give me yours.
lines.zh: : 我会把我自己给你，而你把你自己给我。

lines.en: : And then we will give it all to him.
lines.zh: : 然后我们会把它全部交给祂。

lines.en: : Praise be.
lines.zh: : 赞美圣名。

lines.en: : Sorry, just still figuring out what the hell I’m supposed to add to this conversation.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我只是还在想我到底该接什么话。

lines.en: : I expected things to get a little weird but I didn’t really expect you to go on a rant like that.
lines.zh: : 我料到事情会有点怪，但真没料到你会这么长篇大论。

lines.en: : Though, I probably should have, considering that’s really all you ever do around me.
lines.zh: : 不过我大概该料到的——毕竟你在我面前干的基本就只有这个。

lines.en: : I can’t help that I have many things to say, Sensei. I exist to deliver messages and can not be faulted for being good at my job.
lines.zh: : 我话多，我也没办法，Sensei。我存在的意义就是传递信息，总不能因为擅长自己的工作而被责怪吧。

lines.en: : I hope you’re getting paid well, at least.
lines.zh: : 那我希望你至少薪水不错。

lines.en: : Not yet. But it will all be worth it in the end.
lines.zh: : 还没拿到。不过到最后一切都会值得的。

lines.en: : I hope you will be there to see how beautiful I become.
lines.zh: : 我希望你到时候能在场，看看我会变得有多美。

lines.en: scene black
Yasu says some more stuff about her god or whatever but I zone out and stop listening almost immediately.
lines.zh: Yasu 又说了些关于她的神之类的话，但我走神了，几乎立刻就不听了。

lines.en: Frankly, I’ve been doing that for basically all of our walk tonight.
lines.zh: 说实话，今晚这一路我基本都在走神。

lines.en: It’s not like I’m intentionally ignoring her, though.
lines.zh: 不过我不是故意不理她。

lines.en: And it’s also not like what she’s saying is boring me to the point where I no longer care.
lines.zh: 也不是她说的话无聊到我已经不在乎了。

lines.en: I just can’t manage to prevent my mind from trailing elsewhere.
lines.zh: 我只是没法阻止自己的思绪飘到别处。

lines.en: And before long I get lost.
lines.zh: 而不久之后，我就迷路了。

lines.en: Lost in the artistic sense of the word.
lines.zh: 是「迷路」这个词在艺术意义上的那种迷路。

lines.en: And before I know it, I’m back at the dorm, wishing her sweet dreams.
lines.zh: 而等我回过神来，我已经回到宿舍，祝她好梦了。

lines.en: Though, I doubt she’ll dream of anything.
lines.zh: 不过我怀疑她什么都不会梦到。

lines.en: And if she does, I doubt it will be sweet.
lines.zh: 就算梦到了，我也怀疑不会是甜的。

lines.en: I go home.
lines.zh: 我回家了。
